configuration.message: "Email used when this person appears in an approval chain. Budget and Pro Forma approval rows send notifications here, and Territory VP defaults resolve through it. Leave blank only if the user is never an approver."

"The Creator user this row grants access to - one row per person. Its record ID is what Budget Owner and Pro Forma Owner lookups store. A user with NO row here gets nothing in any widget: that is the closed default."
"Edit every Budget and request regardless of ownership. Edit/delete Budget Modifications and delete requests. Create budgets for unbudgeted subdivisions; new budgets belong to their creator."
"Edits budgets owned by this user; adds no edit access when Edit All Budgets is on. Also creates budgets from Add for subdivisions without a budget. New budgets are assigned to their creator."

"Created so Const Budget Manager can have read-only access to all budget functionality and only create POs, including saving and submitting their own drafts. Edit All and Edit Owned Budgets also retain PO creation."
"Edit any budget approval row - approver, status and sequence - on any budget, not just owned ones."
"Edit the budget approval rows only on budgets this user owns. Has no additional effect when Edit All Approvals is on."
"Send a budget into its approval chain, which locks the budget and notifies the first approver. Without this the user can prepare a budget but not start approvals."
"Change who owns a budget. Ownership is what every Owned permission keys off, so this effectively grants and revokes other people's edit rights."
"See the Budget Import Items tab and the imported line items in it. Read-only on its own - pair with Edit Budget Import Items to let the user change anything."
"Edit and assign imported budget line items - mapping them to budget categories and to a budget. Implies the ability to act on what View Budget Import Items shows."
"Modification admin. Full control of every budget modification and its approval rows, including ones the user did not raise: edit, delete, and act on approvals regardless of owner."
"Full edit on every pro forma regardless of owner. Supersedes Edit Owned Proformas."
"Edit only the pro formas this user owns. Has no additional effect when Edit All Proformas is on."
"Edit the construction cost curve rows that spread a pro forma's costs across time. Off means the curve is visible but locked."
"Delete a pro forma outright, or archive it out of the active list. Destructive - keep this narrow."
"Edit any pro forma approval row - approver, status, sequence - on any pro forma, not just owned ones."
"Edit the pro forma approval rows only on pro formas this user owns. Has no additional effect when Edit All Pro Forma Approvals is on."
"Run the AI check on a Pro Forma and view its review history (Pro Forma Manager AI Review button)."
"Change who owns a pro forma. Ownership drives every Owned permission, so this indirectly grants and revokes other people's edit rights."
"Show the VP Compensation tab on a pro forma. Off hides the tab entirely - use it to keep compensation figures away from users who do not need them."
"Edit a pro forma's probability percentage, which weights it in forecasting and pipeline roll-ups."
"Edit all open contracts and their actions, owners, approvals, attachments, lots and pricing. Includes Edit Owned Contracts and Actions. Completed contracts are read-only for everyone."
"Legal. Accept or decline what appears in the Review queue - proposed contracts and the actions proposed with them. Without this the user sees the queue but only as 'With Legal'."
"Delete and archive contracts access"

"Edit your open contracts and all their actions, owners, approvals, attachments, lots and pricing. You must be added as an owner to edit. New records wait for Legal review. Completed contracts are read-only for everyone."

"Edit the per-contract-type action checklists that seed every new contract of that type. Changing a template changes what every future contract starts with, so this stays off unless explicitly granted."
"Grants access to the Lot Sales dashboard within the Data Insights widget"
"Grants access to Lot Revenue related measures within the Lot Sales dashboard."

"Allows shared approval policies to assign this person to a step. Off blocks routing even when their role assignment is active. Notifications use Approver Email. This does not grant budget editing or approval override permissions."
